name: Proposal App
description:
Proposal App is a government contracting platform built around three things every contractor needs to grow: Find It, Win It, and Scale It. 

Generate a compliant response from any RFP, RFI, or RFQ in approximately 20 minutes. The platform analyzes solicitation documents, builds compliance matrices, produces a scored first draft with gap analysis, and creates risk assessments, project schedules, and work breakdown structures, replacing a process that traditionally takes days or weeks of manual effort across multiple tools.

All-in-one government contracting platform covering federal, state, and local capture management. Combines bid matching, recompete radar, contract intelligence, proposal drafting, market intelligence reports, agency contact search, pipeline management, and team collaboration in a single workflow, eliminating the need to switch between SAM.gov, spreadsheets, and disconnected point solutions.

Start free with 3 proposals and a Market Intelligence Report, no credit card required. Upload your company capabilities and generate your first compliant draft in minutes. Paid plans unlock 10 to 30 proposals per month, advanced analytics, NAICS spend analysis, and multi-user team workspaces for scaling your capture pipeline across dozens of active pursuits simultaneously.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Proposal App to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Proposal App to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://proposalapp.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Proposal App MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proposal App lists 43 MCP tools, including create_capability_statement, create_proposal, create_proposal_from_pipeline, download_polished_export, export_proposal_fast, generate_clarity_qa, generate_market_intel, generate_proposal_draft, get_bid_no_bid_analysis, get_content_generation_status, get_contract_intel, and get_market_intel.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Proposal App?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Proposal App in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Proposal App MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proposal App requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Proposal App is developed by Proposal App. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
